title: Close the authenticated Windows selected-stage log comparison
body:
Closes PR2344's explicit composed-caller/log-policy handoff: execute PR2336's pinned native Windows successor, authenticate all **30 original raw references per side**, then compare **all 105 selected final-stage outputs and the complete outer log** through the unchanged PR2344/2101 predicates. Only the eleven named inner logs and the outer log admit CRLF-to-LF conversion; bare CR and other semantic changes reject. The six exact input roles, invoice policy and fresh timing locations retain their predecessor boundaries.

The original Windows inventory failure and its two `.as_posix()` substitutions belong to PR2316/2336. This contribution adds the complete authenticated composition and exercises it on fresh native output. All eleven vendor files and 43 live scientific inputs retain exact pins. The scientific child runs with assertions enabled even though the registered parent is optimized. Exact Decimal serialization prevents numeric-type or precision loss while rebinding the 22 admitted log references.

Validation: native Windows 11 / CPython 3.12.7 registered replay passed all eleven strict stages, six positive controls and 203 rejecting controls in 258.533 seconds (86.156-second native stage). Controls cover every missing output, repaired semantic log and invoice changes, stale raw links, bare CR, outer-log changes, input-role misbinding, unknown scientific values, invalid JSON and predecessor corruption. Separate AI source/proof review found no blocking issue. A writable workspace TEMP/TMP resolved an initial sandbox environment failure.

This uses authenticated archived PR1042 inputs; it is not cold ancestry replay, a new supplier, a changed selected bound, hosted CI or independent human review. UNC/device roots and unclassified output schemas remain outside the inherited policy. Only `research/selected-windows-log-closure` is added. Base is current canonical main `0fdd7d82`, priority revision 4. Task refinement, overlap evidence, acceptance argument, reproducible hook and bounded next questions are included.

Credit Dennis / antunishdPursuit (PR2336), AAAmirinu (PR2344), Adam Gall (PR2101/2059), commdata2338 (PR2040), josecarlosgonzalezroque-design (PR2316), and the selected supplier lineage documented in the package. Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-windows-log-closure
```
